clause: Preset/composite animation styles + animation-to-reusable-component + AI-keyframe optional lane [STU-PRO-031a,STU-PRO-031b,STU-PRO-032]

scope.summary: Implement preset animation styles (fade, move, scale) and composite styles (multiple presets in one action) applicable to a selection, landing on the timeline at the playhead, and remaining editable for type/settings/duration/easing; converting an animation into a reusable animated StudioComponent (MT-323) whose motion travels with the component across documents; and the OPTIONAL AI-assisted keyframe generation as a model-lane capability that emits real editable StudioMotionTimeline keyframes grounded in the document's components and variables, routed through the sandbox -> validation -> PromotionGate lifecycle and never required to author motion by hand. The AI lane is clearly marked optional/adapter-backed and separable.
acceptance_criteria: preset/composite styles + animation-to-reusable-component + optional AI-keyframe lane via PromotionGate; separable; author_ids + manual entry
proof_targets: Argus preset + to-component + AI-keyframe promotion/separability test
expected_tests: argus: preset/composite animation styles + convert-to-animated-component + AI-keyframe lane (marked optional) reachable via author_ids
live: preset lands on timeline editable; animation converts to reusable animated component; AI keyframes route through PromotionGate (fails closed) and build/validate with the AI lane absent

target_entries: Studio / Motion / Presets, animated components and AI keyframes (optional)

risk_if_missed: No animation presets/reuse; AI lane inseparable or bypasses promotion.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
